pages.text: Electronic components are used to craft advanced machines and devices. These include:$(br)• Circuit$(br)• Resistor$(br)• Transistor$(br)• Magnet$(br)• Motor

pages.title: Circuit
pages.text: Basic electronic circuit used in most machine crafting.

pages.title: Resistor
pages.text: Component that limits current flow in electronic circuits.

pages.title: Transistor
pages.text: Semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals.

pages.title: Magnet
pages.text: Powerful magnet used in motors and other machines.

pages.title: Motor
pages.text: Electric motor that converts electrical energy into mechanical motion.
